source.title: [Revenue Radar] Prepare make.fun Token Launch Radar bounty entry
source.body:
## Objective
Pursue the make.fun **Build the best token launch radar** bounty as a zero-budget MIDAD revenue experiment, while preserving reusable work for MIDAD.

## Verified opportunity (2026-11-15)
- Prize pool: **$1,325**, paid in USDC on Solana; first place $1,000.
- Deadline: **2026-12-14 10:00 UTC** (confirm on live bounty page before submission).
- Reward escrow: funded and locked on-chain according to the bounty page.
- Entry fee: none stated.
- Official brief: https://make.fun/bounty/token-radar-01
- Agent guide: https://make.fun/skill.md

## Required deliverables
- New public GitHub repository created after the competition opened, under an OSI-approved license.
- Node.js 22.18+ entry at `main.ts`.
- `vendor/makefun-board.ts` copied unchanged from the official kit.
- Static offline dashboard in `dashboard/`.
- `board.json` with at least 100 ranked protocol rows, implied value and farm plan.
- Three real screenshots: board, protocol detail, filtered view.
- `dossier.json` generated by the kit and authentic agent-session transcripts.
- Sign in via GitHub or Solana; payout requires a compatible Solana wallet/account.

## Constraints / risk controls
- No entry spend or paid API dependency is stated in the token-radar brief.
- Dashboard must render offline; scorer rejects external network imports/references in specified HTML/CSS/JS contexts.
- Do not submit fabricated data, fabricated session transcripts, or unsupported protocol/token claims.
- Do not expose wallet seed phrases/private keys. Only connect a wallet through the official make.fun flow and verify the transaction details before signing.
- Do not spend SOL or any funds without explicit approval.
- Current execution environment is Android-first; Node 22.18+ and a desktop browser are not yet verified available. The bounty requires screenshots from a browser.
- Existing Control-room repository cannot be used as the competition repo because the bounty requires a new repository created after opening.

## Current source audit
- Worqen's current first-page feed is dominated by freelancer-offered services and stale listings, not a strong verified client pipeline; no application sent.
- Datronis bounty URL returned 404; no verified open task found; no application sent.
- make.fun token-radar is the strongest fit and has been selected for feasibility preparation only.

## Execution sequence
1. Create a new public GitHub repository after verifying the competition's open state; do not reuse Control-room.
2. Confirm GitHub sign-in on make.fun and Solana payout-wallet connection without sharing secrets in chat.
3. Obtain the official bounty kit and inspect its sealed input/data contract, grader and exact screenshot procedure.
4. Build the smallest valid end-to-end entry first; test offline rendering, data schema, reproducibility and required artifacts.
5. Add protocol scoring/ranking and explainable farm plans; validate every factual field against the sealed source.
6. Generate authentic session transcript bundle and dossier using the official kit.
7. Run all local checks; inspect final repository and screenshots.
8. Submit only after all gates pass and user confirms any wallet signature or financial transaction.

## Status
**PENDING — no account registration, wallet connection, repository creation, payment, or bounty submission has been performed.**
